intro: Seven names this week. Some of them you expected. A couple you did not. Every one of them earned it.

hero.label: Shout out of the week · Account Manager · No. 1 on the board
hero.name: James Bradley
hero.line: 1,691 assignments on the month and 80 this week alone. That is not a hot start. That is a workload.

cards.label: Making moves
cards.line: More than doubled his pace in a month. Somebody check what he is drinking.

cards.label: A Team · Top of the board
cards.name: Christina & Rob
cards.line: Most of any team, A, B or C. They are setting the pace for the whole floor.

cards.label: B Team · Most activity on the floor
cards.name: Team 13, Kevin & Leo
cards.line: Plus 35 this week and 436 sold. The nickname is earning its keep.

cards.label: Make An Offer · Week of Sep 14 to 18
cards.line: Led the MAO board. Jonathan Jerry was three back at 83, so this one is a race.

cards.label: Making moves
cards.name: Ian Baxter
cards.line: Up 62% on last month and did it quietly, which is exactly how you would expect him to do it.

cards.label: C Team · Keep climbing
cards.name: Isaiah & Elijah
cards.line: 31 sold so far and the pipeline to keep going. Watch this one next month.

close: If you are on this list, keep setting the pace. If you are not, you are one big week away. There is still plenty of month left.
from: Ken Rion, SVP of Dealer Sales
